# Global Untold Story

Film and video production studio based at Egyptian Media Production City in Cairo, with offices in Dubai and Jeddah.

Site: https://globaluntoldstory.com
Contact: https://globaluntoldstory.com/contact
Email: bendary@globaluntoldstory.com
Phone: +201001299639

## What we do

Full-cycle production for international and regional clients: on-ground production in Egypt (permits, fixing, crew, equipment, locations, logistics), commercial advertising, documentary, corporate and industrial film, live events and broadcast, podcast, post-production, motion/CGI/VFX/AI, dubbing and localisation, commercial photography, performance marketing, and original IP.

## Languages

English (canonical, unprefixed) and Arabic (`/ar`). Other locale prefixes exist for the language switcher but should not be treated as unique translations until their body copy is complete.
